info.name: Non siamo più vivi
info.plot: Un liceo diventa ground zero per un'epidemia di virus zombi. Gli studenti intrappolati devono combattere per uscire o trasformarsi in uno dei rabbiosi infetti.

trailers.name: 점심시간, 급식실로 몰려온 좀비들 | 지금 우리 학교는 | 넷플릭스

translations.value: Un liceo diventa ground zero per un'epidemia di virus zombi. Gli studenti intrappolati devono combattere per uscire o trasformarsi in uno dei rabbiosi infetti.

info.title: Non siamo più vivi
info.synopsis: Un liceo diventa ground zero per un'epidemia di virus zombi. Gli studenti intrappolati devono combattere per uscire o trasformarsi in uno dei rabbiosi infetti.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Inside Lee Byeong-chan's science lab, a student incurs a seemingly harmless bite. Shortly after, a fast-spreading outbreak soaks the school in blood.

translations.value: Inside Lee Byeong-chan's science lab, a student incurs a seemingly harmless bite. Shortly after, a fast-spreading outbreak soaks the school in blood.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: The infected multiply in droves. Scrambling for their lives, Nam On-jo and Lee Cheong-san find safety with others inside a classroom — but not for long.

translations.value: The infected multiply in droves. Scrambling for their lives, Nam On-jo and Lee Cheong-san find safety with others inside a classroom — but not for long.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: When one of the group is scratched while fighting a zombie, Lee Na-yeon demands they kick him out. Outside, the virus swallows up the city.

translations.value: When one of the group is scratched while fighting a zombie, Lee Na-yeon demands they kick him out. Outside, the virus swallows up the city.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: In need of a cellphone, two students take a risky journey to the teachers' office. Byeong-chan passes on critical information to Detective Song Jae-ik.

translations.value: In need of a cellphone, two students take a risky journey to the teachers' office. Byeong-chan passes on critical information to Detective Song Jae-ik.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Martial law is imposed on the city. When Cheong-san is separated from the rest of the group, On-jo leads a mission to use a drone to locate him.

translations.value: Martial law is imposed on the city. When Cheong-san is separated from the rest of the group, On-jo leads a mission to use a drone to locate him.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: The group clears a path to Cheong-san using sound to draw away zombies, but a new type of threat surfaces. Nam So-ju breaks out of the quarantine camp.

translations.value: The group clears a path to Cheong-san using sound to draw away zombies, but a new type of threat surfaces. Nam So-ju breaks out of the quarantine camp.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: To make it out of the music room and onto the roof, the students put into action their most perilous plan yet. Elsewhere, Jae-ik comes across a setback.

translations.value: To make it out of the music room and onto the roof, the students put into action their most perilous plan yet. Elsewhere, Jae-ik comes across a setback.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: Jae-ik and his crew run into a student from the school. Na-yeon works up the courage to face her peers. The group shares confessions around a fire.

translations.value: Jae-ik and his crew run into a student from the school. Na-yeon works up the courage to face her peers. The group shares confessions around a fire.

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: Un incidente al campo cambia l'atteggiamento dell'esercito nei confronti del virus. Un temporale offre protezione mentre il gruppo decide di non fermarsi.

translations.value: Un incidente al campo cambia l'atteggiamento dell'esercito nei confronti del virus. Un temporale offre protezione mentre il gruppo decide di non fermarsi.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.plot: The auditorium quickly becomes a trap for the two newly united teams of survivors. Byeong-chan's video logs reveal a drastic solution to the crisis.

translations.value: The auditorium quickly becomes a trap for the two newly united teams of survivors. Byeong-chan's video logs reveal a drastic solution to the crisis.

episodes.name: Episodio 11
episodes.plot: Though a surprise protector provides the group safe passage to their next stop, Yoon Gwi-nam is not far behind. The military makes a grave decision.

translations.value: Though a surprise protector provides the group safe passage to their next stop, Yoon Gwi-nam is not far behind. The military makes a grave decision.

episodes.name: Episodio 12
episodes.plot: The students make it to the quarantine camp, each of them weighed down by tragic loss. Months later, they hang on to hope for a survivor.

translations.value: The students make it to the quarantine camp, each of them weighed down by tragic loss. Months later, they hang on to hope for a survivor.

translations.title: All of Us Are Dead
translations.overview: A high school becomes ground zero for a zombie virus outbreak. Trapped students must fight their way out — or turn into one of the rabid infected.
translations.tagline: Hope is the most painful torture for people who want to despair.

translations.title: 지금 우리 학교는
translations.overview: 좀비 바이러스 발생의 시발점이 된 고등학교. 이곳에 갇힌 학생들은 필사적으로 탈출구를 찾아야만 한다. 그렇지 않으면 감염되어 좀비가 될 뿐.
